candidate_relations.reason: Warthin tumor is a benign oncocytic lymphoid neoplasm, not intraductal carcinoma.
Intraductal carcinoma is a salivary gland tumor, but this label omits the required intraductal carcinoma subtype.
Pleomorphic adenoma is a benign mixed tumor and is incompatible with intraductal carcinoma.
Lymphoma is a hematolymphoid malignancy rather than intraductal salivary carcinoma.
Salivary duct carcinoma was an initial cytologic consideration, but it is distinct from the benchmark intraductal carcinoma.
Mucoepidermoid carcinoma is a separate histologic salivary malignancy, not intraductal carcinoma.
The label asserts benign salivary disease, whereas intraductal carcinoma is a malignant epithelial neoplasm.
Warthin's tumor is a benign oncocytic lymphoid neoplasm, not intraductal carcinoma.
Acinic cell carcinoma is a distinct salivary malignancy with acinar differentiation.
Metastatic disease denotes spread from another primary site, whereas the benchmark is a primary intraductal carcinoma.
